entwurf.thema: Claude Code: I Built My Own TV Operating System With Claude Code

teile.name: Overhead
teile.text: Your prompt arrives after thousands of tokens. Systima's test measured that overhead in Claude Code.
teile.szene: Black-haired presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits in a dim apartment at night, eyebrows raised in worry, city lights behind him. Medium shot, painted open-world-game poster style, bold ink contours.

teile.name: Token overhead
teile.text: Systima's test saw Claude Code send about 33,000 tokens for a one-line reply. OpenCode sent about 7,000.
teile.szene: Systima blog post section comparing Claude Code and OpenCode token overhead on a one-line reply.

teile.name: Tokens not prices
teile.text: Those are token counts. No supplied source gives an official price, so we can't turn them into a cost.
teile.szene: Presenter with cyan glasses and leather jacket shrugs honestly, palms open, in a bright modern workspace. Medium shot, soft daylight, painted open-world-game poster style, calm space above and below.

teile.name: Spending caps
teile.text: Can you cap it? The docs list max turns and max budget flags for print mode, plus a spend limit.
teile.szene: Official Claude Code best practices documentation table row showing how much it spends: max turns, max budget and a spend limit.

teile.name: Instruction files
teile.text: A 72KB production instruction file added about 20,000 tokens on average, and it lands on every single request.
teile.szene: Systima blog passage on instruction files adding about 20,000 tokens to every request.

teile.name: What loads first
teile.text: Systima counted system prompts, tool schemas and instruction files first. The docs say: write down only what Claude can't find.
teile.szene: Presenter with cyan glasses and black leather jacket leans back in a dim apartment at night, relieved smile, hands behind his head, city lights behind him. Medium shot, warm lamp light, painted open-world-game poster style.

teile.name: Engagement
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Presenter with glowing cyan glasses and black leather jacket smiles and gives a thumbs up, in front of a calm city rooftop at dusk. Medium shot, warm light, painted open-world-game poster style.

entwurf.beschreibung: One Systima test counted about 33,000 tokens in Claude Code before a one-line prompt arrived. Anthropic's docs list ways to cap spending and keep instructions lean.
